key.name: daemon-enabled
key.description: Whether to run the screensaver automatically when idle.

key.name: idle-timeout
key.description: Idle time in minutes before the screensaver starts.

key.name: multi-monitor
key.description: Show the screensaver on every connected monitor instead of just one.

key.description: The screensaver to run when idle.

key.description: Keep an icon in the system tray, and minimize to it rather than quitting when the window is closed.
